note.en: 【接點修補 2026-11-01】Added Spanish Sahara, Ifni and missing Canary Islands (from OHM 2862762 v19 via the 1939-03 records).　【接點修補 2026-11-01】After the trial window: unchanged (includes the northern protectorate; later batch). [tail-1945-09c] Geometry minus the Spanish protectorate in Morocco (overlap of 20,723 km² removed).
note.zh-Hant: 【接點修補 2026-11-01】補上西屬撒哈拉、伊夫尼與加那利群島缺塊（取自 1939-04-01 前的國民軍／共和國紀錄幾何，即 OHM 2862762 v19；扣除同期其他紀錄）。　【接點修補 2026-11-01】1945-09-03 起為本批試驗期間外，範圍原樣（含保護國北區，待後續批次處理）。 【tail-1945-09c】幾何扣掉 spanish-protectorate-morocco（原多 20,723 km²，得土安落在本國內），與 1939-04-01 段一致。
